title: MBz loves MM5
description: Exposes the MusicBrainz IDs MediaMonkey keeps in its database but never shows: Albums.MBGID (release), Albums.MBRGGID (release group) and Artists.MBGID (artist). Adds three read-only tracklist columns plus a dialog that lists, copies and can set those IDs for the album or artist of the selected tracks.
author: NiZDesign
